title: container: Run Linux containers natively on your Mac #GitHubTrending #github #devtools

sections.title: Transcript
paragraphs: Ever wished you could run Linux containers on your Mac without the slowdowns or hacks? Container makes it happen. Super lightweight, blazing fast, and fully optimized for Apple silicon. It handles OCI compatible images so you can pull, run, and push containers anywhere. Built on the containerization Swift package, it manages everything under the hood, containers, images, processes effortlessly. One tool, native speed, perfect for testing, development, or running Linux right on your
